grant_age_3.notes: Grant for a child born from 1.1.2017 (the 2017+ cohort; children born earlier get a grant at 18 instead). 2026 amount. Paid at age 3. 250 NIS in 2017 (law); 284 in 2025 (NII report). CPI-updated each 1 January from 2017 (s.74ג(ג)).

grant_bar_mitzvah.notes: Grant for a child born from 1.1.2017 (the 2017+ cohort; children born earlier get a grant at 18 instead). 2026 amount. Paid at age 13 for a boy and age 12 for a girl (the rule's wording: 'NIS 291 at age 13 (boys) or 12 (girls)'). 250 NIS in 2017 (law); 284 in 2025 (NII report). CPI-updated each 1 January.

source.title: National Insurance Institute, child savings: withdrawal page; savings-amount page; law 74ב(א)(1), 74ג(ב)-(ג)

grant_age_21.notes: Grant for a child born from 1.1.2017 (the 2017+ cohort; children born earlier get a grant at 18 instead). 2026 amount. Paid at age 21, only if nothing (even partially) was withdrawn before 21 (s.74ג(ב)). 500 NIS in 2017 (law); 568 in 2025 (NII report). Same amount for every cohort.
